external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
external_entities.notes: trust_zone is unknown because the sources do not state where members or their phones are located.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk personnel who use the circulation page to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff identity and branch cannot be determined from the history.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members borrow, renew, and reserve books, and which calls the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the service interface for loans and applies loan rules while reading and writing loan records.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The sources disagree about exposure. Lending service note: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is also an honest gap: Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where a member scans a library card and books, sending loan and return events to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: Priya could not say what the kiosks talk to beyond what arrives at the API.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, member contact details, and full borrowing history.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The interview corrects the former two-database arrangement: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: use library app
data_flows.description: A member uses the phone application to borrow, renew, or reserve a book.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: submit loan requests
data_flows.description: The library app submits member and book details to the lending API for renewals and reservations.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member
data_flows.notes: Authentication is unknown. Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: The member and book for a renewal or reservation

data_flows.name: scan loan items
data_flows.description: A member scans a library card and books at a self-service kiosk.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning
data_flows.data_description: A library card and books being borrowed or returned

data_flows.name: send loan records
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each loan and return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_flows.name: change loan records
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: All desk staff use one shared login; the password is on a card taped under the desk. The history records only that the loan was closed by hand.
data_flows.data_description: Loan extensions, account-block changes, and manual returns

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations, contact details, and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch self-service kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data-centre zone where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network through which phones reach the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.

assumptions.basis: The database contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and every member's full borrowing history.
